About this report

Kilde builds each profile from Norway’s public registers and the company’s own website. For every fact it keeps the web address, the time it was read and the exact text, so anyone can check it. Nothing is estimated: missing figures are shown as missing, never as zero.

Sources and licences

Contains data under the Norwegian licence for Open Government data (NLOD) distributed by Brønnøysundregistrene.

Industry, sector and legal-form names from Statistics Norway (SSB) Klass, licensed CC BY 4.0.
